note: Seychelles, read on the Immigration and Civil Status Department's own pages on 2026-10-30. A Gainful Occupation Permit lets its holder work as an employee or as a self-employed person; for a job the employer first gets the Ministry of Employment and Social Affairs' approval certificate, then applies to the Immigration office at least a week before the work starts, and the employee may not enter to take up the job before the permit is issued (abroad; the game reads it as work for the sponsor, the employee's case). It costs SCR 1,000 to process (kept) plus SCR 500 a month or part of one for the permit's whole duration, which the form doesn't hold; permits can be collected 1 to 5 days after the application. Its term isn't stated. The Permanent Residence Permit lets its holder work without a GOP and be exempt from any other permit; the categories and years that lead to it, its fee and where it's applied for aren't on the page ('in country' is the game's reading). Naturalisation's years weren't read.

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status (Seychelles), Gainful Occupation Permit
sources.said: A Gainful Occupation Permit (GOP) allows the holder to be gainfully occupied in Seychelles and this could be as an employee or as a self‐employed person. ... an Applications for Gainful Occupation Permits should then be submitted to the Immigration office, Independence House, Victoria at least one week before the employee is due to start work. ... The prospective employee must not enter Seychelles for the purpose of taking up employment prior to obtaining the Gainful Occupation Permit. ... There is a processing fee of SCR. 1,000/‐ for processing of the application. The fee for the whole duration of the permit being sought at Sr.500 per month or part thereof, is payable when submitting the application. ... Gainful occupation permits (GOP) can be collected between 1 - 5 days after submission of application.
